subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Mother tried to ______ the child when he was crying for a toy.
solution:
The correct answer is **'distract.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the options.
 
 
• **Attract** means to cause someone to have a liking for or interest in something.
 
• **Distract **means to prevent someone from concentrating on something.
 
• **Disturb** means interrupting sleep, relaxation, or privacy.
 
• **Absorb **means to take up the attention of someone or interest greatly.
 
 
 
• When we look at the sentence, we observe that t***he child was crying for a toy and the mother would try to prevent him from concentrating on the toy so that he may stop crying.***
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

**So, the sentence would be - ***Mother tried to **distract** the child when he was crying for a toy.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the words with some more examples.
 
 
• He did not want to **attract **her attention.
 
• My friend always **distracts** my attention from my study.
 
• I have told you many times not to **disturb** me.
 
• He sat in an armchair, **absorbed** in a novel.
